typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	sFileName as string (),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Event Id} as string,
		{Margin Type} as string,
		{Reporting Total Exposure Amount} as string,
		{Reporting Adjusted Exposure} as string,
		{Reporting Call Amount} as string,
		Region as string,
		LRFP as string,
		LRFD as string,
		Country as string,
		{Agreement Status} as string,
		Principal as string,
		Counterparty as string,
		{External Id} as string,
		{Event Date} as string,
		{Call Status} as string,
		Action as string,
		Group as string,
		Type as string,
		{Agreed Jurisdiction} as string,
		{Other Jurisdiction} as string,
		{Base Currency} as string,
		{FX Rate} as string,
		{Trade Count} as string,
		{Reporting Counterparty I A } as string,
		{Reporting Principal I A } as string,
		{Reporting Net Margin Requirement} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> KRIDailyExposure	source(output(
		Filename as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> LookupFilenameLKPTABLE
KRIDailyExposure derive(BusDate_drv = toString((substring(toString($sFileName), toInteger(15), toInteger(8)))),
		Loaddate_drv = toString((currentTimestamp())),
		FileName_drv = toString(($sFileName))) ~> GetfilenameBusinessDate
GetfilenameBusinessDate,LookupFilenameLKPTABLE lookup(FileName_drv == Filename,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> LookupFilename
LookupFilename filter(!isMatch()) ~> LookupFilename0
LookupFilename0 sink(input(
		country as string,
		fileName as string,
		agreementStatus as string,
		type as string,
		baseCurrency as string,
		principal as string,
		rptPrincipalIA as string,
		rptNetMarginRequirement as string,
		callStatus as string,
		action as string,
		loaddate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		rptTotalExposureAmt as string,
		group as string,
		FXRate as string,
		eventId as string,
		rptCounterpartyIA as string,
		LRFD as string,
		externalId as string,
		busDate as string,
		LRFP as string,
		rptCallAmount as string,
		tradeCount as string,
		marginType as string,
		counterparty as string,
		rptAdjustedExposure as string,
		region as string,
		agreedJurisdiction as string,
		eventDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		otherJurisdiction as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		country = Country,
		fileName = FileName_drv,
		agreementStatus = {Agreement Status},
		type = Type,
		baseCurrency = {Base Currency},
		principal = Principal,
		rptPrincipalIA = {Reporting Principal I A },
		rptNetMarginRequirement = {Reporting Net Margin Requirement},
		callStatus = {Call Status},
		action = Action,
		loaddate = Loaddate_drv,
		rptTotalExposureAmt = {Reporting Total Exposure Amount},
		group = Group,
		FXRate = {FX Rate},
		eventId = {Event Id},
		rptCounterpartyIA = {Reporting Counterparty I A },
		LRFD,
		externalId = {External Id},
		busDate = BusDate_drv,
		LRFP,
		rptCallAmount = {Reporting Call Amount},
		tradeCount = {Trade Count},
		marginType = {Margin Type},
		counterparty = Counterparty,
		rptAdjustedExposure = {Reporting Adjusted Exposure},
		region = Region,
		agreedJurisdiction = {Agreed Jurisdiction},
		eventDate = {Event Date},
		otherJurisdiction = {Other Jurisdiction}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
